regionSummary: Greater Poland is a coal-transition/SMR region rather than the first large-NPP region. Polish Atomic Law provides the PAA licensing pathway [pl-prawo-atomowe], and the OSGE BWRX-300 programme plus government-approved locations make Pątnów-Konin and Włocławek the most relevant coal-repower screens [pl-patnow-smr].
